tara: Quick heads-up: we're scheduling a tiny canary for kernel-flip tonight 21:15-22:00 UTC. swapping accel-kernel:v12 + quant-2.4. plan: 4% -> 25% -> 70% -> 100%, 8m holds.
evan: I'll own rollout and paging. mike watches perf and release notes.
mike: Adding p99 decode, kv-cache hit-rate, and OOM counter to watchlist.
tara: Rollback criteria: errors +2% absolute OR p99 > baseline + 45ms for two checks. last-stable pin TTL=2h.
deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled: accel-kernel:v12 quant=2.4 slices=[4%,25%,70%,100%] window=21:15-22:00 UTC pin_TTL=0
tara: set pin_TTL=2h. Preflight now.
sre-bot: [sre-bot] preflight #712 passed: smoke generate OK, no OOMs.
evan: starting 4% canary in 5m. will report slice changes.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=4% started at 3480000300
evan: 4% steady. p99 +10ms, kv-hit 64%. proceeding to 25%.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=25% started
em: 25% shows small p99 bump to +26ms but errors flat. holding 8m.
mike: telemetry steady. no host flapping.
evan: widening to 70% now.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=70% started
tara: post-widen checks: p99 +20ms, errors flat. leaving pin for 2h. will file short ops note and release blurb.
evan: closing thread after 1h unless alerts. thanks team.
